sources.title: D3 Turbo - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: D3 Turbo is the upgraded 27B multimodal decision model in vLLM Semantic Router's Decision 3.0 family. Given text, JSON, images, or video alongside a set of named questions, it answers each with a probability instead of generated text, supporting choice, yes/no, score, box localization, and tracking questions in a single forward pass.

sources.title: d3 - ollama.com
sources.snippet: d3 is a family of decision models from vLLM Semantic Router. Give it text, structured state, or a still image, then ask it to choose a category, answer yes or no, or rate something on a scale.

sources.title: d3-turbo - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: d3-turbo is a multimodal decision model in the Decision 3.0 family from the vLLM Semantic Router team. It produces structured decisions and probabilities rather than free-form generated text. [2][7] Its published package contains a Qwen3.5-based backbone, a vision encoder and a separate answer readout.
